text: 金十数据8月11日讯，国风新材发布异动公告，公司股票2026年8月10日、8月11日连续2个交易日累计涨幅偏离超过20%，根据《深圳证券交易所股票上市规则》的有关规定，属于股票交易异常波动情形。公司近期关注到网络媒体存在公司年产10亿平米光学级聚酯基膜项目G1线建设情况的报道与传闻，公司年产10亿平光学级聚酯基膜G1线虽已完成设备安装，但目前仍处于设备调试及工艺参数的精细化调校阶段，暂未进行MLCC离型膜用聚酯基膜产品生产。
text_en: Jin Shi Data August 11 - Guofeng New Material issued an abnormal movement announcement. The company's stock accumulated a price increase deviation exceeding 20% over two consecutive trading days on August 10 and August 11, 2026, which constitutes an abnormal stock trading fluctuation under the relevant provisions of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange Stock Listing Rules. The company recently noticed online media reports and rumors about the construction of the G1 line of its 1 billion square meters per year optical-grade polyester base film project. Although equipment installation for the G1 line of the 1 billion square meter optical-grade polyester base film project has been completed, it is currently still in the stage of equipment debugging and fine-tuning of process parameters, and production of polyester base film for MLCC release film has not yet commenced.
